job.label: Short bow — Celestial
job.keep_line: the same single short deep D-curved ash bow, upper nock at upper-left and lower nock at lower-right of its gentle diagonal, thick short limbs tapering to rounded nocks, broad spirally rawhide-wrapped grip on the curved right side and a single straight taut dark string closing the D on the left. Preserve the exact limb curvature, wood facets, nock-end cord bindings, rawhide overlaps, open interior and string endpoints; the nocks do not curl or reflex. Pale ash and natural tan rawhide, no coloured maker accent. No arrow, quiver or added hardware.
job.prompt:
Create the Celestial-finish cosmetic variant of the attached fictional RPG short bow inventory painting for Project Heaven Cry. This is a 2D digital game-art asset. FIRST attachment fixes Standard geometry and registration: a single deep D-shaped short bow, rounded nocks at upper-left and lower-right, broad spiral grip wrap on the curved right side, straight taut string closing the D on the left. Preserve exact limb curvature, every opening, nock/string endpoints, grip overlaps, pose, scale, camera and margins. SECOND is the preceding grade: retain its additions except the current material changes. THIRD is Heavenprint brushwork reference only, never a person or scene.

Grade: Celestial. Keep the shape, the inlay and the ferrule's place. The wood becomes a pale ivory wood with no grain flaw, leather a pale hide, a string pale silk, the metal pearl-ivory. The inlay line gives a faint, contained ivory-gold light from inside, nothing past the outline: no bloom, no halo, no rays, no sparks.

Keep the prior Relic tiny grip ferrule and single lower-limb repair binding in EXACTLY their existing locations, shapes and seams. Pale ivory wood, pale-hide grip, pale-silk string and pearl-ivory caps/ferrule; no relocation or deletion of repair or ornament. Both limb inlay routes give only faint contained ivory-gold inner light; no halo or light outside the bow. Apply this grade only to the actual bow parts shown; no stock, quiver, arrow, added fittings or extra object. No curled/reflexed tips. Do not add, remove, resize or move any part or opening. Hand-painted opaque gouache and ink with broken directional strokes, selective dry-brush, charcoal shadows, warm ivory focal edges and upper-left light. Full transparent background,1024x1024RGBA, same framing and at least50px clear margin. No cast shadow, ground, scene, figure, hand, text, letters, numbers, logo, label, frame or border. Exterior painted illustration only, no diagram, measurements, assembly steps or operating instructions.
